title: From Review to Authorization: Key-Isolated Threshold Signing for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous LLM agents can turn untrusted content into effectful actions such as payments and permission changes. If the same process interprets this content and controls a reusable signing credential, prompt injection can cross the judgment boundary and reach execution authority. We present KITA, a review-to-authorization architecture that keeps the user's personal secret signing key and every threshold signing-key share outside all LLM processes. Under threshold signature unforgeability and our system assumptions, compromising the proposer and fewer than t reviewer-signer domains cannot produce a valid authorization for a new action without signing contributions from t distinct domains. Thus, any such authorization includes a share from an uncompromised domain, bound to the canonical action and released only after authenticated reviewer approval. translated_title: 从审查到授权：面向大语言模型智能体的密钥隔离门限签名
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05901v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：自主的大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以将不可信内容转化为具有实际影响的操作，例如支付和权限更改。如果同一个进程既解释这些内容，又控制可重复使用的签名凭证，那么提示注入就可能跨越判断边界并触及执行权限。我们提出了KITA，这是一种从审查到授权的架构，它将用户的个人秘密签名密钥以及所有门限签名密钥份额都隔离在所有LLM进程之外。在门限签名不可伪造性和我们的系统假设下，即使攻击者攻陷了提议者以及少于t个审查者-签名者域，也无法在没有来自t个不同域的签名贡献的情况下为新操作生成有效授权。因此，任何此类授权都必然包含来自未被攻陷域的份额，该份额与规范操作绑定，并且仅在经过身份验证的审查者批准后才被释放。这确立了执行绑定的授权完整性。我们实现了完整的审查……（原文在此截断）
tldr: KITA架构通过将用户签名密钥和门限签名密钥份额完全隔离在所有LLM进程之外，使提示注入攻击无法从内容判断跨越到执行权限，为大语言模型智能体建立了执行绑定的授权完整性保障。
en_tdlr: KITA is a review-to-authorization architecture that keeps users' signing keys and threshold signing-key shares outside all LLM processes, preventing prompt injections from crossing the judgment boundary to execution authority and establishing execution-bound authorization integrity for LLM agents.
